fields.v: Benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified (500), SWE-Rebench 2026.03 (110), SWE-QA. Configurations: text-only vs vision-only (3 models), text vs multimodal (4 models), layouts, depths, stages (GPT-5-mini). Baseline: text-only Mini-SWE-Agent. Held constant: scaffold, temperature 0, 250-step and $3 budgets, all settings except structural context. Acceptance: benchmark unit tests / SWE-QA scoring. Repetitions: averaged over 3 independent runs. Human intervention: none

Vision-only worst for all models (-13.6 to -34.1 pp, cost +27% to +268%). Multimodal reduces cost (GPT-5-mini -26%, GPT-5.1 -46%, Kimi -3%, Doubao -6%) with Pass@1 change -2.2 to +1.8 pp. Graph layout most token-efficient; tabular highest Pass@1 (56.2%); depth 4 best Pass@1 (57.2%); localization stage best, repair (-5.0) and validation (-3.4) worse. No significance tests or variance reported; accuracy differences mostly < 2 pp

Clearly distinguished vision-only and stage variants; small multimodal Pass@1 differences not tested for significance. Repeatability: 3-run averages, spread not reported. Limitations stated: Python only; tokens and trajectory length as efficiency proxies; model-specific tool-use tendencies

Python-only benchmark (generalisation to Java/TypeScript unclear); efficiency proxies miss qualitative reasoning aspects (no human evaluation); model-architecture interactions; static Graphviz layouts dense for large repositories; future: adaptive visualisation, learned invocation policies, dynamic/runtime signals

Inconsistency: text-only baselines differ between Table 1 and Table 2 (Kimi K2.5 Pass@1 70.3% vs 68.8%, API calls 40 vs 41, input tokens 639,474 vs 691,141, cost $0.1213 vs $0.1270; Doubao input tokens 201,754 vs 185,311, cost $0.019 vs $0.0173); abstract says four models but RQ1 uses three. Abstract: input tokens reduced 'by up to 26%', but Table 2 gives at most -25% input tokens (26% is the cost reduction; Table 3, SWE-Rebench: -34.89%). Tables rebuilt from pdftotext output (column values split across lines). Data and artefacts at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19229174. Pre-registration: Not stated. Language: Python
